# Contributing — aig-MONOREPO

Review standards live in `docs/CODE-REVIEW.md`. This file is the workflow.

## Workflow

1. Branch from `main`: `feat/<slug>`, `fix/<slug>`, `docs/<slug>`, `chore/<slug>`.
2. Keep PRs small (<400 lines) and single-concern.
3. Fill the PR template, including test evidence.
4. Green local gates required (no CI: Actions OFF by owner decision) —
   `secret-guard`, `ruff` on changed files, `pytest`.
5. Merge via squash. No direct pushes to `main`.

## Commit style

`<type>(<scope>): <imperative summary>` — e.g. `fix(auth): reject expired JWT on /api/*`.

# Tenants white-label

Esta carpeta está ignorada por git (`tenants/`) porque contiene secretos y
DBs generadas por tenant. La única excepción versionada es `_example/`,
que sirve de plantilla para `config/docker-compose.enterprise.yml`
(`tenants/<slug>.env` + DBs).

Para crear un tenant real:

1. Copia `_example/` a `tenants/<slug>/` (nunca se commitea).
2. Rellena `<slug>.env` con valores reales (ver `.env.master.example`).
3. Levanta con `docker compose -f config/docker-compose.enterprise.yml up -d`.
